purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Contai

queries.query: Contai West Bengal official cadastral map parcel GIS land records
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of West Bengal BanglarBhumi land-record portal, the West Bengal State Geoportal, the Directorate of Registration and Stamp Revenue property search, and the national Department of Land Resources directory linking West Bengal's official RoR portal. No anonymous Contai parcel feature response was identified.

queries.query: কাঁথি কনটাই পশ্চিমবঙ্গ সরকারি জমির মানচিত্র খতিয়ান ক্যাডাস্ট্রাল
queries.result: Bengali first-party-oriented discovery confirmed the West Bengal land-record terminology খতিয়ান/দাগ and the official BanglarBhumi land-record portal as the relevant state service. Search results did not expose a public Contai parcel API or safe ID-plus-geometry response.

registryEvidence.custodian: Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department, Government of West Bengal; BanglarBhumi state land-record service
registryEvidence.scope: Official state land-record and cadastral-map procedure evidence relevant to West Bengal, including Contai/Kanthi in Purba Medinipur; no Contai-specific open vector endpoint was verified.

officialSources.publisher: Government of West Bengal, Land and Land Reforms Department
officialSources.observation: Official Know Your Property land-record entry point discovered; anonymous fetch timed out before viewer configuration could be inspected.

officialSources.publisher: Government of West Bengal State Geoportal
officialSources.observation: Official geoportal advertises public spatial resources and WMS; anonymous fetch timed out before service metadata could be inspected.

officialSources.publisher: Directorate of Registration and Stamp Revenue, Government of West Bengal
officialSources.observation: Official property-registration search was discovered; no cadastral geometry response was obtained and no unsafe property fields were requested.

officialSources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
officialSources.observation: Official directory links West Bengal's BanglarBhumi RoR portal and describes cadastral-map/spatial-data services; this is national directory evidence, not Contai-specific coverage.
